ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: The Art and Life of Georgia O'Keeffe. There is an upcoming O'Keeffe exhibition in the works at the Phillips Collection, The Whitney Museum and the O'Keeffe Museum in Santa Fe. We will take a field trip to Santa Fe, NM to see the artist's work and the site where the artist lived and painted. The travel cost will be about $1000 per student but we do have some funding to subsidize students who cannot afford the travel or need help. Open to all University students. Graduate section.
